jouav_cw_80e.notes: Official page lists wind resistance Grade 7-8 / 13.9-20.7 m/s; NIWA stores the conservative lower bound.

deltaquad_evo.name: DeltaQuad Evo
deltaquad_evo.notes: Official flight specifications list max wind speed 12.5 m/s during takeoff/landing and 14 m/s during cruise; NIWA stores the conservative takeoff/landing value.

ascent_spirit.name: Ascent AeroSystems Spirit
ascent_spirit.notes: Official page lists Class 8 wind resistance and 40+ mph; NIWA stores 40 mph / 17.9 m/s as the conservative published threshold.

teledyne_flir_siras.name: Teledyne FLIR SIRAS
teledyne_flir_siras.notes: Official Teledyne FLIR support article lists maximum wind speed 22 mph / Beaufort 5, approximately 10 m/s.

teal_2.name: Teal 2
teal_2.notes: Official specs list sustained wind limit 18 mph and gusts to 25 mph; NIWA stores the sustained wind value.

airobotics_optimus.name: Airobotics Optimus
airobotics_optimus.notes: Official system specifications list wind operation up to 25 knots.

hoverfly_sentry.name: Hoverfly SENTRY
hoverfly_sentry.notes: Official specs list sustained winds of 25 mph and gusts of 30 mph; NIWA stores the sustained wind value.

fotokite_sigma.name: Fotokite Sigma
fotokite_sigma.notes: Structured public-safety retailer specification lists operation in wind speeds up to 25 mph / 40 km/h. NIWA marks this as non-official until a Fotokite-hosted numeric spec is verified.

harris_aerial_carrier_h6_efi.name: Harris Aerial Carrier H6 EFI
harris_aerial_carrier_h6_efi.notes: Official brochure lists maximum wind speed 25 mph / 11 m/s.

acecore_zoe.name: Acecore Zoe
acecore_zoe.notes: Official commercial drones page lists wind resistance 35 knots.

acecore_noa_hybrid.name: Acecore Noa Hybrid
acecore_noa_hybrid.notes: Official commercial drones page lists wind resistance 29 knots.

acecore_zetona.name: Acecore Zetona
acecore_zetona.notes: Official commercial drones page lists wind resistance 25 knots.

microdrones_md4_1000.name: Microdrones md4-1000
microdrones_md4_1000.notes: Official product information says steady pictures are possible in winds up to 6 m/s; NIWA treats this as operational guidance rather than a formal max wind resistance.

ideaforge_switch.name: ideaForge SWITCH UAV
ideaforge_switch.notes: Distributor specifications list maximum allowable wind speed 20 km/h for takeoff/landing and 40 km/h in flight; NIWA stores the conservative takeoff/landing value.

ideaforge_netra_v4_plus.name: ideaForge NETRA V4+
ideaforge_netra_v4_plus.notes: Official product sheet lists wind resistance 10 m/s.

ideaforge_netra_v4_pro.name: ideaForge NETRA V4 PRO
ideaforge_netra_v4_pro.notes: Official NETRA V4 product sheet lists wind resistance 10 m/s for V4+ and V4 PRO variants.
